# Validation fixtures

Generated by the oracles in `scripts/validation/` (except
`literature_barriers.json`, hand-curated from experimental data — see its
`source` fields). Do not edit by hand; every file has a deterministic
generator and a Rust consumer (`tests/cross_validation.rs` for most;
`cpm_lammps.json` → `tests/experimental/test_cpm.rs`,
`reaxff_lammps.json` → `tests/alpha_reaxff_validation.rs`,
`literature_barriers.json` → `tests/literature_barriers.rs`,
per-ficha gates `tests/{alpha,beta}_*_validation.rs`, see Ficha column).

## Regenerate

```bash
python scripts/validation/oracle_rdkit.py all
```

Tool versions used for the checked-in fixtures are recorded in
`validation/refs.lock.json` (repo root). The oracles require RDKit and
FreeSASA; the Rust tests only need the JSON fixtures.

F49 additionally reads `tests/fixtures/experimental_reference.json`
(NIST/CCCBDB experimental IR bands, checked in; shared with other suites).
